// Synthetic Grafana builder probes against the pinned real Tempo engine/Parquet.
package vparquet4

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"sort"
	"testing"

	"github.com/gogo/protobuf/proto"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/v3/pkg/tempopb"
	cv "github.com/grafana/tempo/v3/pkg/tempopb/common/v1"
	rv "github.com/grafana/tempo/v3/pkg/tempopb/resource/v1"
	tv "github.com/grafana/tempo/v3/pkg/tempopb/trace/v1"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/v3/pkg/traceql"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/v3/tempodb/backend"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/v3/tempodb/encoding/common"
)

func TestPulseBuilderDiscovery(t *testing.T) {
	dir := "/tmp/pulse-tempo-builder-discovery"
	if err := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0755); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	sv := func(s string) *cv.AnyValue { return &cv.AnyValue{Value: &cv.AnyValue_StringValue{StringValue: s}} }
	bv := func(v bool) *cv.AnyValue { return &cv.AnyValue{Value: &cv.AnyValue_BoolValue{BoolValue: v}} }
	iv := func(v int64) *cv.AnyValue { return &cv.AnyValue{Value: &cv.AnyValue_IntValue{IntValue: v}} }
	fv := func(v float64) *cv.AnyValue { return &cv.AnyValue{Value: &cv.AnyValue_DoubleValue{DoubleValue: v}} }
	kv := func(k string, v *cv.AnyValue) *cv.KeyValue { return &cv.KeyValue{Key: k, Value: v} }
	all := &tempopb.Trace{}
	for i, name := range []string{"request", "leaf", "other"} {
		tid, sid := make([]byte, 16), make([]byte, 8)
		tid[0] = 0x11
		tid[15] = 1
		sid[0] = 0x11
		sid[7] = byte(i + 1)
		if i == 2 {
			tid[15] = 2
		}
		var parent []byte
		if i == 1 {
			parent = make([]byte, 8)
			parent[0] = 0x11
			parent[7] = 1
		}
		start := []uint64{100000000000, 7300000000000, 101000000000}[i]
		duration := []uint64{2000000, 3000000, 1000000000}[i]
		attrs := []*cv.KeyValue{kv("choice", sv(name)), kv("cached", bv(i == 1)), kv("score", fv(float64(i)+0.25)), kv("count", iv(int64(i+1))), kv("a b", sv(name))}
		sp := &tv.Span{TraceId: tid, SpanId: sid, ParentSpanId: parent, Name: name, Kind: tv.Span_SpanKind(i + 1), StartTimeUnixNano: start, EndTimeUnixNano: start + duration, Attributes: attrs, Status: &tv.Status{Code: tv.Status_StatusCode(i), Message: []string{"", "timeout", "done"}[i]}}
		if i == 1 {
			sp.Events = []*tv.Span_Event{{Name: "exception", TimeUnixNano: start + 100, Attributes: []*cv.KeyValue{kv("message", sv("boom")), kv("retry", bv(true)), kv("code", iv(7)), kv("load", fv(2.5))}}}
			lt, ls := make([]byte, 16), make([]byte, 8)
			lt[0] = 0x22
			lt[15] = 9
			ls[0] = 0x22
			ls[7] = 8
			sp.Links = []*tv.Span_Link{{TraceId: lt, SpanId: ls, Attributes: []*cv.KeyValue{kv("reason", sv("retry")), kv("retry", bv(true)), kv("code", iv(9)), kv("load", fv(3.5))}}}
		}
		service := []string{"shop", "worker", "other"}[i]
		r := &tv.ResourceSpans{Resource: &rv.Resource{Attributes: []*cv.KeyValue{kv("service.name", sv(service)), kv("cached", bv(false)), kv("a b", sv("resource"))}}, ScopeSpans: []*tv.ScopeSpans{{Scope: &cv.InstrumentationScope{Name: []string{"http", "db", "test"}[i], Version: "1.2", Attributes: []*cv.KeyValue{kv("language", sv(service)), kv("retry", bv(i == 1)), kv("code", iv(int64(i+2))), kv("load", fv(float64(i)+1.5))}}, Spans: []*tv.Span{sp}}}}
		all.ResourceSpans = append(all.ResourceSpans, r)
	}
	grouped := map[string]*tempopb.Trace{}
	for _, r := range all.ResourceSpans {
		id := string(r.ScopeSpans[0].Spans[0].TraceId)
		if grouped[id] == nil {
			grouped[id] = &tempopb.Trace{}
		}
		grouped[id].ResourceSpans = append(grouped[id].ResourceSpans, r)
	}
	var rows []*Trace
	for id, tr := range grouped {
		row, _ := traceToParquet(&backend.BlockMeta{}, []byte(id), tr, nil)
		rows = append(rows, row)
	}
	block := makeBackendBlockWithTraces(t, rows)
	queries := []string{
		`{span.cached=true}`, `{span.score>1.0}`, `{span.count>=2}`, `{span.cached=false || span.score>1.0}`, `{span.cached=false && span.score>1.0}`,
		`{span."a b"="leaf"}`, `{resource."a b"="resource"}`, `{.cached=true}`,
		`{name="leaf"}`, `{span:name="leaf"}`, `{kind=server}`, `{span:kind=server}`, `{status=ok}`, `{span:status=ok}`,
		`{statusMessage="timeout"}`, `{span:statusMessage="timeout"}`, `{duration>2ms}`, `{span:duration>2ms}`,
		`{rootName="request"}`, `{trace:rootName="request"}`, `{rootServiceName="shop"}`, `{trace:rootService="shop"}`,
		`{traceDuration>1h}`, `{trace:duration>1h}`, `{trace:id="11000000000000000000000000000001"}`, `{span:id="1100000000000002"}`, `{span:parentID="1100000000000001"}`,
		`{event:name="exception"}`, `{event:timeSinceStart=100ns}`, `{event.retry=true}`, `{event.code=7}`, `{event.load=2.5}`,
		`{instrumentation:name="db"}`, `{instrumentation:version="1.2"}`, `{instrumentation.retry=true}`, `{instrumentation.code=3}`, `{instrumentation.load=2.5}`,
		`{link:spanID="2200000000000008"}`, `{link:traceID="22000000000000000000000000000009"}`, `{link.retry=true}`, `{link.code=9}`, `{link.load=3.5}`,
	}
	type Case struct {
		Query    string      `json:"query"`
		Target   string      `json:"target"`
		Response interface{} `json:"response"`
	}
	cases := []Case{}
	// Project a separate stored attribute; no engine same-target literal shortcut.
	var probes [][2]string
	for _, q := range queries {
		probes = append(probes, [2]string{q, "span.choice"})
	}
	for _, target := range []string{"trace:id", "span:id", "span:parentID", "link:traceID", "link:spanID", "instrumentation.language", "event.message", "link.reason", "name", "rootName", "trace:duration"} {
		probes = append(probes, [2]string{`{span.cached=true}`, target})
	}
	for _, probe := range probes {
		q, target := probe[0], probe[1]
		groups, err := traceql.ExtractConditionGroups(q, traceql.DefaultMaxConditionGroupsPerTagQuery)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("%s: %v", q, err)
		}
		tag, err := traceql.ParseIdentifier(target)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		values := map[tempopb.TagValue]bool{}
		fetch := traceql.NewTagValuesFetcherWrapper(func(ctx context.Context, req traceql.FetchTagValuesRequest, cb traceql.FetchTagValuesCallback) error {
			return block.FetchTagValues(ctx, req, cb, func(uint64) {}, common.DefaultSearchOptions())
		})
		err = traceql.NewEngine().ExecuteTagValues(context.Background(), tag, groups, traceql.MakeCollectTagValueFunc(func(v tempopb.TagValue) bool { values[v] = true; return false }), fetch, 0)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("%s: %v", q, err)
		}
		vals := []tempopb.TagValue{}
		for v := range values {
			vals = append(vals, v)
		}
		sort.Slice(vals, func(i, j int) bool {
			if vals[i].Type != vals[j].Type {
				return vals[i].Type < vals[j].Type
			}
			return vals[i].Value < vals[j].Value
		})
		cases = append(cases, Case{q, target, map[string]interface{}{"tagValues": vals}})
	}
	wire, err := proto.Marshal(all)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err = os.WriteFile(dir+"/builder-discovery-input.protobuf", wire, 0644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	out, err := json.MarshalIndent(cases, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err = os.WriteFile(dir+"/builder-discovery-oracle.json", append(out, '\n'), 0644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Logf("actual engine/Parquet values: %d", len(cases))
}
